entries.description: Continuation of a listing for a 22-acre homestead run by two lesbian women earning income from bees, honey, rare poultry, graphic design, photography, organic agriculture writing, and making t-shirts and rubber stamps as Armadillo Mountain. Offers apprenticeships and work exchanges in beekeeping and dryland permaculture.
entries.raw_text: oriented homestead whose main farm income is from sales of bees and honey and from hatching rare breeds of poultry. Off-farm income is derived from graphic design, photography and writing for the organic agriculture journals. We also produce and sell lesbian/feminist t-shirts and rubber stamps under the name of Armadillo Mountain. Would welcome correspondence with other lesbians on the land. Longer-term apprenticeships/work exchanges are a possibility. Would also trade apprenticeships in beekeeping and Permaculture (particularly dryland and forage systems) for some good, solid vocational skills, especially carpentry and stone masonry. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 22 acres, good tools and equipment, dogs, cats, chickens, ducks, guineas, peabirds and 60 zillion bees.
entries.notes: Continues from previous page. Type is Private/Individual Land by the two-woman rule ('We have/are: 2 lesbians' on a 'homestead'). num_residents is 2 ('homestead', '2 lesbians'). Accepted groups: Lesbian women ('2 lesbians', 'correspondence with other lesbians'). Focuses: Farming/self-sufficiency ('homestead whose main farm income is from sales of bees and honey and from hatching rare breeds of poultry'), Workshops/education ('apprenticeships/work exchanges', 'trade apprenticeships in beekeeping and Permaculture'), Archives/cultural work ('produce and sell lesbian/feminist t-shirts and rubber stamps'), Environmentalism/eco-friendly ('Permaculture (particularly dryland and forage systems)').

entries.description: A 147-acre land trust farm in Oregon with two lesbian women caretaking, seeking energy and money support to revive an inactive group and stay open for lesbian women, non-lesbian women, girl children, and boy children under 10, especially encouraging women of color.
entries.raw_text: OWL FARM POB 133, Days Creek, OR 97429. We are two wimmin caretaking OWL since Aug 82. OWL is needing energy and money support from wimmin to stay open for wimmin & children. No abuse of alcohol, drugs, or violence. I encourage wimmin of color to come and be here. We welcome: new members/caretakers, girl children, boy children (under 10 years), nonlesbian women, dogs only if restrained, donations. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 147 acres, housing/permanent structures, camping space, woods, farm land, wimmin living and working the land. Inactive group with hopes to revive.
entries.notes: Type is Land Trust (OWL is Oregon Women's Land Trust, as stated in the next listing on this page, and is an 'Inactive group with hopes to revive' with 'two wimmin caretaking OWL' welcoming 'new members/caretakers'; even without the next listing, two caretakers recruiting 'new members/caretakers' is Intentional Community/Cooperative or Land Trust). Address is a PO Box; land_state OR inferred from mailing state. num_residents is 2 ('We are two wimmin caretaking OWL', '2 lesbians... wimmin living and working the land'). Accepted groups: Lesbian women (questionnaire directory, '2 lesbians'), Non-lesbian women ('nonlesbian women'), Girl children ('girl children'), Boy children ('boy children (under 10 years)'). Focuses: Recovery/substance-free ('No abuse of alcohol, drugs, or violence'), Women of color ('I encourage wimmin of color to come and be here').

entries.description: A women's land trust in Oregon in the process of buying Owl Farm, supported by donations, printing a quarterly newsletter, and caretaken by a fluctuating collective of women. Welcomes lesbian women, non-lesbian women, girl children, and boy children.
entries.raw_text: OREGON WOMEN'S LAND TRUST PO Box 1692, Roseburg, OR 97470. OWLT is in the process of buying OWL FARM (see above). Support for the farm and trust comes from donations from those women who believe in land for women. A quarterly newsletter is printed, $5/year. Land trust meetings are held about every three months at the farm. A collective of women (the number fluctuates) caretakes the farm. We welcome: new members, girl and boy children, nonlesbian women.
entries.notes: Type is Land Trust ('OREGON WOMEN'S LAND TRUST', 'Land trust meetings'). Address is a PO Box; land_state OR inferred from mailing state and name. num_residents left blank because 'A collective of women (the number fluctuates) caretakes the farm' gives no number. Accepted groups: Lesbian women (questionnaire directory), Non-lesbian women ('nonlesbian women'), Girl children and Boy children ('girl and boy children').

entries.description: A family of four lesbian women living on 40 acres on a secluded forest hilltop in Oregon, growing food, making art and song, and inviting lesbian and non-lesbian women to workshops in theatre and Tai Chi several times a year.
entries.raw_text: FLY AWAY HOME POB 593, Myrtle Creek, OR 97457. We are a family of 4 lesbians living on a secluded forest hilltop. We grow food and tender our emotional and spiritual depths. And we make art and song that celebrate woman. We invite women to our workshops in Theatre and in Tai Chi several times during the year. We are unable to welcome visitors at other times. We have/are: 4 lesbians, 40 acres, housing/permanent structures, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative ('We are a family of 4 lesbians living on a secluded forest hilltop'). Address is a PO Box; land_state OR inferred from mailing state. num_residents is 4 ('4 lesbians living...'). Accepted groups: Lesbian women and Non-lesbian women ('We invite women to our workshops' in a pre-1986 directory, plus '4 lesbians'). Focuses: Spirituality/ritual ('tender our emotional and spiritual depths', 'celebrate woman'), Farming/self-sufficiency ('We grow food'), Workshops/education ('workshops in Theatre and in Tai Chi'), Archives/cultural work ('we make art and song that celebrate woman').

entries.description: A partnership of two lesbian women owning and living on 130 acres of forested land in Roseburg, Oregon, with a cabin, outbuildings, garden, and chickens, managing woods by thinning and reforestation. Welcomes lesbian women, non-lesbian women, girl children, and boy children.
entries.raw_text: STEPPING WOODS Rt 4 Box 1058, Roseburg, OR 97470. We are a partnership of 2 lesbians owning 130 acres of forested property. We manage our woods by thinning and reforestation, where necessary, for selective timber harvest and firewood. There is one woman-built cabin, a few out buildings, a garden, chickens, and pets. We are not separatists and have male friends that come on our land. We welcome: girl and boy children, nonlesbian women. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 130 acres, housing/permanent structures, electricity/privy, camping space, woods, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Private/Individual Land by the two-woman rule ('We are a partnership of 2 lesbians owning 130 acres'). Land address copied from rural route mailing address ('Rt 4 Box 1058'). num_residents is 2 ('2 lesbians... women living and working on the land'). Accepted groups: Lesbian women ('2 lesbians', questionnaire directory), Non-lesbian women ('nonlesbian women'), Girl children and Boy children ('girl and boy children'). Visiting 'male friends that come on our land' are not coded per codebook ('visiting friends are not coded', and males are not on the 'We welcome:' list). Explicit rejection of separatism noted ('We are not separatists'). Focuses: Farming/self-sufficiency ('a garden, chickens', firewood harvest), Environmentalism/eco-friendly ('We manage our woods by thinning and reforestation, where necessary, for selective timber harvest').

entries.description: Two lesbian women, aged 57 and 60, living on over 6 acres in Sunny Valley, Oregon, running a rural feminist publishing center (Womanspirit and The Blatant Image) with interests in photography (summer Ovulars), ecology, and alternative technology. Welcomes lesbian and non-lesbian women for visits and projects; no men, guns, pets, or drugs.
entries.raw_text: ROOTWORKS 2000 King Mountain Trail, Sunny Valley, OR 97497. A rural feminist publishing center (Womanspirit and The Blatant Image) with strong interests in photography, (summer Ovulars), ecology and alternative technology. We are 57 & 60 years old. We enjoy the company and help of women of all ages who can adapt to our simple lifestyle for short or long visits. Rules: no men, guns, pets, drugs or dope. Smoking limited to outdoors gravel area. $4/day/woman includes vegetarian meals. We welcome: nonlesbian women, women to help on projects. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 6+ acres, housing/permanent structures, outdoor toilets, electricity with generator and batteries, camping space, woods, gardens, women living and working with the land.
entries.notes: Type is Private/Individual Land by the two-woman rule ('We are 57 & 60 years old', 'We have/are: 2 lesbians'); also functions as a publishing center/retreat ('A rural feminist publishing center', '$4/day/woman'). Land address copied from street/road mailing address ('2000 King Mountain Trail'). Acreage is '6+ acres', stored as 6. num_residents is 2 ('2 lesbians... women living and working with the land'). Accepted groups: Lesbian women and Non-lesbian women ('nonlesbian women', 'women of all ages'). 'Rules: no men'. Focuses: Recovery/substance-free ('Rules: no... drugs or dope'), Workshops/education ('(summer Ovulars)'), Archives/cultural work ('A rural feminist publishing center (Womanspirit and The Blatant Image) with strong interests in photography'), Environmentalism/eco-friendly ('strong interests in... ecology and alternative technology').

entries.land_location_as_stated: situated on a large island off the coast of Maine
entries.description: A women's rooming and guest house run by two lesbian women in a restored Victorian house on a large island off the coast of Maine, welcoming lesbian women, non-lesbian women, and girl children.
entries.raw_text: SEA GNOMES HOME Box 33, Stonington, ME 04681 (207)367-5376. We are a womyn's rooming/guest house situated on a large island off the coast of Maine. Rooms are $21 including tax. The house is a large Victorian, partially restored, one bathroom, kitchen use, large parlour. We welcome: girl children, nonlesbian women. We are/have: 2 lesbians, 1 dog, 1 cat, house, plumbing/electricity.
entries.notes: Printed under "EDITORS' NOTE: These groups don't have land, perse, but we decided to include them for your information." (GABRIEL'S in Provincetown above this is excluded per codebook: 'Not rows: ... apartments or guest rooms in a town with no land (Gabriel's in Provincetown)'). Sea Gnomes Home is a rural/island guest house ('womyn's rooming/guest house situated on a large island off the coast of Maine', 'The house is a large Victorian'), so included as a row with type Retreat/Gathering Space ('guest house'). Address is a PO Box ('Box 33'), but Stonington is the town on Deer Isle ('situated on a large island off the coast of Maine'), so land_city is Stonington and land_state is ME. num_residents is 2 ('We are/have: 2 lesbians... house' running the guest house). Accepted groups: Lesbian women ('2 lesbians', questionnaire directory), Non-lesbian women ('nonlesbian women'), Girl children ('girl children').

entries.description: Notice that Ozark Wimmin's Land Trust's multiple-ownership land holdings ended in legal dissolution, though a large women's community exists in the Fayetteville, Arkansas area for those searching for land.
entries.raw_text: OZARK WIMMIN'S LAND TRUST PO Box 718, Fayetteville, AR 72702. We have tried multiple-ownership (partnership) type of land holding. The pieces of land wound up in legal dissolution eventually. Some of us persevere in the spirit. We cannot guarantee to answer letters, but if you are prepared to spend a little time in the area, a land search may be fruitful. A large wimmin's community exists.
entries.notes: Not a listing: notice that the community's land has ended ('The pieces of land wound up in legal dissolution eventually', explicitly cited as an example of not_a_listing in the codebook). Printed under the editors' note for groups that don't have land.
